items.title: Centre Waives Excise Duty on 22% to 30% Ethanol-Blended Petrol
items.whyInNews: The Union Government has waived the excise duty on 22% to 30% ethanol-blended petrol to promote the use of eco-friendly fuels and reduce dependence on fossil fuels. This move is expected to increase the production and consumption of ethanol-blended petrol in India.
items.summary: The Centre's decision to waive excise duty on 22% to 30% ethanol-blended petrol is a significant step towards promoting the use of eco-friendly fuels in India. This move is expected to reduce the country's dependence on fossil fuels and decrease greenhouse gas emissions. The waiver will also encourage the production and consumption of ethanol-blended petrol, which will have a positive impact on the environment.

items.whyInNews: A recent study has found that the human contribution to global warming has reached its highest level ever in 2025. The study attributes the increase to the growing levels of greenhouse gas emissions.

The findings of the study have significant implications for climate change mitigation efforts.
